cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I planned the picnic, so I choose cake first. You remember how I taught you to organize a day out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, my route worked. Planning first, driving second. You're moving up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I baked the cake. The baker gets the big end piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Baking outranks driving. But I taught you that recipe, so instruction goes above baking. Cut your teacher the end piece; you've earned second choice.
